title: Target queue tess-periodic-01
summary: Ranked target queue from the NASA Exoplanet Archive TOI table (pl_orbper > 0 AND tfopwg_disp IN ('PC','APC'); top 1000). No light curve is analysed here; each target becomes its own known-object campaign. Runner: Target queue: 1000 of 5225 pool members ranked by depth_ppm * sqrt(duration_h) * 10**(-0.2*(tmag-10)).
